lens: Has the prose drifted from the artifacts it quotes since it was written, and did any earlier correction land only half way?
what_i_read: git log --follow and git show on the manuscript (1a50079a3 2026-08-09 12:19, 0dce79be0 2026-08-12) and on both artifacts
central_claim: Of five therapeutic classes selected by a molecular state rather than a histology, four of the selecting states are absent in EMC on the only public expression data, one class survives, and the paper's methodological point is that the four negatives differ in strength and must be reported separately rather than summed.

blockers.summary: Section 1's bolded exhaustiveness claim -- 'Two public series -- the only readable EMC expression data that exists' -- is false against this repository's own committed record AT THIS COMMIT, and the record predates the paper by four days. A third readable EMC-labelled expression datapoint is on file, with processed expression downloadable.
blockers.evidence: research/method-watch-triggers.json, triggers[21] (TRG-EMC-EXPRESSION-DATASET), carries a field literally named '_third_series_2026_08_05' whose text begins: 'A THIRD readable EMC expression datapoint, and it is the first in an ATR-directed dataset: GSE299349 (Cancer Letters 2026, PMID 41651400) carries GSM9037837 / USZ-23_EMC3 -- a patient-derived EMC-labelled cell model with its own Salmon quantification, beside 62 sarcoma tumours and 5 other patient-derived models.' The same trigger's sibling field '_partially_satisfied_2026_08_05' is what the paper's 'two series' sentence rests on. research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md section 8.1 confirms readability in the ordinary sense: 'every one of the 68 samples carries its own Salmon .quant.sf.gz, so processed expression is downloadable without touching a FASTQ', and section 8.2 Q2 records 'YES -- one. GSM9037837, title USZ-23_EMC3'. The paper was written 2026-08-09 12:19:46 (commit 1a50079a3), four days after that record; its prose has never been edited since (git diff 1a50079a3 -> 20d33f3 on this path returns only four relative-link path changes from the 2026-08-12 directory move, commit 0dce79be0). The paper does not name GSE299349 or PMID 41651400 anywhere (grep count 0), nor does its class-definitions anchor research/literature/biomarker-class-definitions-2026-08-09.json.
blockers.what_edit_would_break_it: Qualify the sentence to what is true -- these are the only readable EMC expression data in which the histology appears as a scoreable group of tumours -- and add the third datapoint with the caveats the record already carries: n = 1, a patient-derived cell model rather than a tumour, no fusion call deposited, and the repo's own identity check returning LABEL_WEAKLY_CORROBORATED_AND_THE_COMPARISON_IS_CONFOUNDED (NR4A3 rank 4/68 on cross-sample TPM but 29/68 on the index-robust family fraction, quantified against a different reference index from its 67 comparators). The results do not move; the Limits section's 'Sixteen tumours' stops reading as a ceiling nobody could have exceeded and starts reading as the defensible choice it actually is.

blockers.summary: The paper's two limitation statements both say 'three of the five', and the paper's own five sections say five. The undercount runs in the direction that makes two of the negatives sound instrument-adequate when sections 2.1 and 2.2 explicitly say they are not.
blockers.evidence: Line 178: 'For three of the five the deciding measurement is a protein, a mutation or a functional assay, and each is named in its own section.' Line 200: 'A transcript is not a protein, a mutation or a dependency, and for three of the five classes the selecting feature is one of those three rather than a transcript level.' Counting from the paper's own text: 2.1 'ASS1 loss in the source literature is an immunohistochemistry call, and a transcript is not a protein' (protein) with falsifier F1 asking for ASS1 immunohistochemistry; 2.2 'This cannot establish that TP53 is wild-type or mutant, and it does not' (mutation) with F2 asking for 'a TP53 sequence call'; 2.3 'The approved indication is selected by protein loss' (protein) with F3 asking for INI1/SMARCB1 immunohistochemistry; 2.4 'An HR defect is usually a mutation' (mutation) with F4 asking for 'a mutational or genomic-scar readout'; 2.5 'That is a dependency, and the method that measures it is BH3 profiling' (dependency/functional) with F7 asking for BH3 profiling. That is five of five, and line 178's own clause 'and each is named in its own section' is the tell -- all five sections name one. Even the most generous alternative reading (treating the p53 axis's 'transcriptionally live' half as transcript-readable) gives four, not three. Under no reading of the paper's text is the number three.
blockers.what_edit_would_break_it: Change both occurrences to 'all five' (or state four with the p53 exception spelled out). As written a reader concludes that for two of the five the transcript IS the deciding measurement, which sections 2.1 and 2.2 deny in their own words -- and this is the paper whose stated central claim is that grading each negative's strength 'is the whole job'.

p1s.summary: HALF-APPLIED CORRECTION, and the correction record itself names the half that was missed. The POLQ grade was corrected on 2026-08-09 11:46 (commit 325be1158, 'correct the POLQ grade -- one half of the combination IS present, and the first grade said neither was'). The paper under review was written 33 minutes later and carries the CORRECTED reading. The sibling census still carries the SUPERSEDED one, 23 days later.
p1s.evidence: research/manuscripts/modality-census/cancer-modality-census.md line 196: '| POL-theta | excluded -- neither half of the required combination |'. research/modalities/census-route-expression-grading.json routes['RT-POLQ'].verdict at this commit: 'NOT SUPPORTED -- the required COMBINATION is absent, because the homologous-recombination half is not there. [warning] Not because neither half is: the alt-EJ half is present on both platforms.' The same route carries a field named '⚠_correction_2026_08_09' reading: 'This grade first read "POLQ is flat and sits low on its array" and concluded "neither half of the required combination", and THE ROUTE AND CENSUS ROW INHERITED THAT. ... The VERDICT is unchanged -- the combination is still absent -- but the reason given was wrong, and it was found by reading the panel again while drafting the paper that would have quoted it.' The census row is the named inheritor and was never fixed. The paper's 2.4 is starred on the opposite reading -- 'The alt-EJ half IS present, concordantly ... (t = 2.42 and 2.23)' -- which matches the artifact exactly (alt_ej_module t = 2.423 / 2.226). This is the corrected half certifying the stale half: publishing the paper puts a starred positive observation in print beside a repo document that says the observation was not made.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Rewrite cancer-modality-census.md line 196 to the artifact's current verdict, with a superseded-retained note, since section 3.2a is a record of what a prediction returned and its 'five of the six were excluded' tally must survive the fix (it does -- the verdict is unchanged, only the reason).

p1s.summary: A second surviving superseded verdict in the same sibling file, three rows below: a route the grading artifact records as WITHDRAWN still stands there as 'supported', and the census sentence asserts the exact property the withdrawal was based on refuting.
p1s.evidence: cancer-modality-census.md line 296: '| hypoxia-activated prodrugs | **supported** -- and the only one supported concordantly on both platforms |'. census-route-expression-grading.json routes['RT-HYPOXIA-PRODRUG'].verdict: 'WITHDRAWN -- first graded SUPPORTED from the raw contrast; the confound audit restricts the signature to ONE OF THE TWO PLATFORMS and the memo that owns it declines to license this class from the signal at all', with route_action 'withdrawn; the owning memo's ruling stands and this grader defers to it' and the artifact's summary block listing RT-HYPOXIA-PRODRUG under 'withdrawn'. 'Supported concordantly on both platforms' is precisely the claim the confound audit removed. Reported because it is the same table, the same artifact and the same defect class as the POLQ row above; it does not bear on this paper's five classes.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Replace the census row with the withdrawal and its reason, pointing at emc-hypoxia-reading.md section 5 as the owning memo.

p1s.summary: The fix that exists to stop exactly this paper's failure mode was applied to its sibling and not to it. This manuscript quotes fifteen figures from emc-expression-panels.json and has NO entry in pinned-figures.json, so nothing in CI can detect drift between this paper and the artifact it depends on.
p1s.evidence: Commit 9861e9bf3 (2026-08-09) is titled 'pin the preprint's figures so the paper cannot drift from the panel'; census-route-expression-grading.json still carries the resulting block 'pinned_figures_quoted_by_the_preprint': {mat2a_percentile_gpl6244: 99, mat2a_percentile_gpl3290: 84, prmt5_percentile_gpl6244: 91, prmt5_percentile_gpl3290: 59}, which belongs to research/manuscripts/mtap-prmt5/emc-mtap-prmt5-hypothesis.md. That document IS one of pinned-figures.json's 26 targets; research/manuscripts/dependency/emc-biomarker-selected-classes.md is not, and the string 'emc-expression-panels' does not appear in pinned-figures.json at all. Both papers quote the same regenerated artifact; one is guarded and one is not. CLAUDE.md section 1.3 is explicit that pinned-figures.json 'is how CI finds the copies you missed'.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Add a target for this document pinning at minimum the eight group t values, the ASS1 array percentile and the NOXA delta, in the same commit as any future change to them.

p2s.summary: 'No SWI/SNF tumour-suppressor subunit reads anywhere near a floor' is an absolute-level phrasing supported by a relative contrast. The strongest counter-datum is ARID1A on GPL3290 at the 18th array percentile.
p2s.evidence: gene_reads.ARID1A GSE4303-GPL3290 EMC mean_array_percentile 0.1825. The claim survives on the contrast the paper actually quotes -- ARID1A is +0.0877 SD ABOVE its comparators there, and the group t is -1.02 and -0.08 -- but 'anywhere near a floor' invites an absolute reading the data does not carry on that platform. Other members: SMARCB1 0.7744 / 0.5187, SMARCA4 0.818 / 0.5341, PBRM1 0.5512 / 0.3579.

p2s.summary: The dependency sentence gives no denominator, in a repository that ran a correction sweep on exactly that denominator after this paper was written.
p2s.evidence: Section 2.5 says 'MCL1 and BCL2L1 are dependencies in the large majority of sarcoma lines'. depmap-sarcoma-dependency.json: sarcoma_frac_dependent 0.835 and 0.758, n_sarcoma 91, n_sarcoma_models 176, threshold -0.5. The grading artifact's corresponding sentence WAS corrected between 1a50079a3 and this commit, from 'Across 176 sarcoma lines' to 'Across the 91 screened sarcoma lines (of 176 sarcoma models)' -- research-ledger.json line 9382 records that sweep as complete in the trunk. The paper never printed a denominator, so it never carried the error; this is a clean escape rather than a defect, but the reader is not told that 83.5% and 75.8% are of 91 screened lines.

p2s.summary: Section 1 reads a property of a governed object without naming it, so the guard sweep that exists for that object cannot see this sentence.
p2s.evidence: 'the one line carrying the disease's label is recorded as not harbouring the fusion' is an accurate and correctly hedged restatement of emc-systems-map.json OBJ-LINE-HEMCSS identity.verdict = NOT_FUSION_POSITIVE_PER_CURATED_RECORD, evidence_verbatim 'Caution: Does not harbor a gene fusion involving EWSR1 ... (PubMed=34413129)'. But the object's read_by sweep (which the O4 preflight gate enforces, and which fires on the alias strings H-EMC-SS / ACH-001519) does not list this manuscript, because the manuscript names neither. The record itself says the verdict does NOT establish what the line is instead; if it moves, the sweep will not find this sentence.

p2s.summary: Section 2.4 and falsifier F4 name an HRD readout as 'the single most likely way this paper is wrong', while a published HRD-selected ATR programme in sarcoma sits unread-in-this-paper in the repository.
p2s.evidence: emc-atr-vulnerability-assessment.md section 8.2 Q3: GSE299349 / Planas-Paz et al., Cancer Letters 2026, PMID 41651400, 'SELECTS_ON_HRD_NOT_ON_FET_FUSION_STATUS' -- the series defines a SARC-HRD signature of ten homologous-recombination-repair genes and nominates ATR/CHK1/WEE1 for sarcoma with HRDness traits. The assessment's own judgement is that it 'moves nothing here and it is not a grade-mover: no EMC tumour signature, no dependency, no ATRi response', so this does not refute 2.4 -- but F4's decisive test now has a named programme running it in this tumour class, and the paper does not say so.

_verdict_note: supported_with_reservations rather than not_supported_as_written, because every measurement the paper prints is correct and I verified them against the artifact as it stands AND at every regeneration since. All eight group t values reproduce exactly at this commit: p53_transcriptional_output -2.203 / -1.126 (paper -2.20 / -1.13), anti_apoptotic_the_druggable_ones -4.568 / -2.538 (-4.57 / -2.54), prc2_core -0.216 / 1.714 (-0.22 / 1.71), swi_snf_tumour_suppressors -1.024 / -0.083 (-1.02 / -0.08), alt_ej_module 2.423 / 2.226 (2.42 / 2.23), homologous_recombination -0.573 / 1.035 (-0.57 / 1.04), nhej_contrast -0.192 / 0.158 (-0.19 / 0.16). ASS1 EMC mean_array_percentile 0.9152 = the 92nd percentile, and higher than comparators on both (delta +0.4787 / +1.5503). NOXA/PMAIP1 higher on both (+0.2292 / +1.7441), the GPL3290 figure being the quoted 1.74 SD. MCL1 and BCL2L1 lower on both individually as claimed. Series counts 6/29 and 10/6 summing to the stated 16. Dependency fractions 0.835 and 0.758 support 'the large majority'. The alt-EJ member claim and the H-EMC-SS identity sentence both mirror their artifacts' own wording. CRITICALLY, the panel artifact was regenerated four times since the prose was frozen -- 0dce79be0 (gen 2026-08-09), 96c5b5b20 (2026-08-24), 1c226db19 (2026-08-27), 89218de88 (2026-08-29) -- and I read every one of those ten figures out of all four: not one value moved. This paper's prose has not been edited since 2026-08-09 (the only later commit touching it, 0dce79be0, changed four relative link paths in a directory move), so the drift this seat exists to find did not happen on the numbers. What did happen is at the edges: an exhaustiveness claim about the world that the repo contradicted four days before the paper was written, a self-referential count that the paper's own sections refute, and two superseded verdicts still standing in the sibling census -- one of which the correcting artifact explicitly names as an uncorrected inheritor. Not not_supported_as_written, because no interpretation of any measurement is reversed and no negative is reported at the wrong strength in sections 2.1-2.5. Not supported, because two sentences are false as written and both fail in the direction of sounding stronger and more complete than the evidence.
